summary: Tested ChatGPT-style conversation threads end to end, backend and frontend. Backend: 31/31 pytest tests pass (tests/test_threads.py). They cover GET /api/threads/{presence} filtering, ordering, titles and counts for ansel, claude, jasmine, louis_lot, sophia, kalahar and the registry presence elowen (presence_sessions); soft-delete and 404s; reopening an ended 72h-old thread via session_id on all 7 start routes; refusing to reopen another user's thread; auto-resume under 2h, new_thread, and no resume for a 3h-old thread; the forge_ledger _claim_unforged unit test (no re-forge); and one real DeepSeek flow on Ansel where the reopened thread remembers its context. Frontend: louis_lot full flow passes with a real message (list, New thread, reopen, send into the reopened thread, reload keeps the same thread, leaving to /presences and coming back starts a new thread, delete Cancel and Confirm, deleting the open thread starts a new one). Ansel, Claude, Jasmine and Sophia each pass: Threads pill shown, seeded threads listed, reopen shows the messages, reload keeps the same thread, 'open now' marker shown, New thread gives a fresh session. A real message sent into a reopened Ansel thread works. All tests ran as QA identity qa-threads-ui1 by intercepting /api/identity/recent. No data was created under user_id 'david'.

ui_bugs.issue: On mobile the pill is fixed at left-4 bottom-28 (y~698-732). In /resonance/chamber it sits on top of the mic button ('Click to speak to Ansel') at the bottom-left, so the mic can't be tapped there. On /presence/louis_lot it overlaps the bottom edge of the chat card. Mirror and Clarity probably have the same overlap (their mic buttons are also bottom-left).

issues: A fresh thread with only the welcome message is not listed. So right after New thread or a return visit, nothing is marked 'open now' until the first message is sent. This matches the spec (>=2 messages) but may confuse users a little.

action_items: Mobile: move the Threads pill so it doesn't cover the chamber mic button and input area (e.g. put it in the header, or use a higher bottom offset / top placement on small screens).
critical_code_review_comments: threads.find_resumable: reopening by session_id returns None when a session has no messages. That's fine, but a session_id that is unknown or belongs to someone else silently gives a fresh thread with no signal to the UI. Consider returning a flag such as requested_thread_unavailable so the UI can show a toast.
list_threads sorts on last_activity as an ISO string. Mixed 'Z' and '+00:00' timestamp formats could misorder rows from the same second (low risk).

find_resumable writes the forge_ledger with $max(len(messages)) whenever an ended thread is reopened, even if that thread was never actually forged (e.g. the end beacon got lost). Messages from such a thread will then never be forged. Low risk, but worth knowing.
server.py is 5750 lines and should be split (the thread start logic is repeated across the 4 legacy start routes).

context_for_next_testing_agent: To keep the UI on a QA identity, intercept **/api/identity/recent with page.route returning {user_name:'QA Threads Tester', user_id:'qa-threads-ui1'}, and set the localStorage keys sanctuary_user_id/sanctuary_user_name in an init script. Seed threads with: python /app/backend/tests/seed_threads_ui.py <uid>. Message input testids: PresenceChamber chamber-input/chamber-send, Ansel message-input/send-message-btn, Mirror mirror-input/mirror-send, Clarity clarity-pod-chat-input/clarity-send-btn. The /resonance/message response key is 'response', not 'message'.
